decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposal contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and numbered Design and Access Statement, PL01Rev0, PL02Rev0, PL03Rev0, PL04Rev0, PL05Rev0, PL06Rev0, SP01, Received 27 September 2011 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extensions, without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The lower sash window within the eastern side elevation of the extension shall remain translucent glass, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with translucent glass.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the occupation of the extensions, details shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority of the internal lighting arrangement within the rear extension and atrium. The details submitted shall demonstrate that there is no light spill to the neighbouring property at 27 Grove Park Road. 

The extensions shall be carried out and maintained thereafter as approved, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Prior to the commencement of development on the site details shall be submitted and approved by the Local Planning Authority of the proposed glass for the external side panel of the rear extension and atrium. The glass shall be translucent glass. 

The extensions shall be carried out and maintained thereafter as approved, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of double storey side extension to a lower ground and ground floor level, and a double storey rear extension at lower ground level
